stem.en: A particular medication is known to cause a specific birth defect only when taken during weeks 4-6 of pregnancy, with no effect at other times. What does this best illustrate?
stem.et: Teadaolevalt põhjustab kindel ravim spetsiifilist sünnidefekti ainult siis, kui seda võetakse raseduse 4.-6. nädalal, mõjuta muudel aegadel. Mida see kõige paremini illustreerib?

label.en: Teratogens typically disrupt development only during a specific critical window when the affected structure is actively forming, so the timing of exposure -- not just its presence -- determines the outcome.
label.et: Teratogeenid häirivad arengut tavaliselt ainult spetsiifilise kriitilise akna jooksul, mil mõjutatud struktuur aktiivselt moodustub, mistõttu kokkupuute ajastus -- mitte ainult selle olemasolu -- määrab tulemuse.

label.en: This must be an unusual exception -- most teratogens are dangerous throughout the entire pregnancy regardless of timing.
label.et: See peab olema ebatavaline erand -- enamik teratogeene on ohtlikud kogu raseduse vältel, sõltumata ajastusest.

label.en: Since a specific external substance is responsible, this defect cannot have any genetic contribution at all.
label.et: Kuna vastutav on konkreetne väline aine, ei saa sellel defektil olla üldse mingit geneetilist panust.

label.en: Every pregnancy exposed to this medication during weeks 4-6 must develop the identical defect with identical severity, since a known teratogenic mechanism guarantees a uniform outcome.
label.et: Iga rasedus, mis puutub selle ravimiga kokku 4.-6. nädalal, peab arenema identse defektiga identses raskusastmes, kuna teadaolev teratogeenne mehhanism tagab ühtlase tulemuse.
